title: Anti-unification and generalization with negatives, vacuity and held-out coverage

endpoint.primary: the pair (registered disposition, held-out coverage vector), scored as an exact match
endpoint.note: Computing the LGG alone is deliberately NOT the endpoint: Plotkin's algorithm decides it exactly, so a study built on it would report parent sufficiency by construction. The endpoint adds negative examples, a vacuity criterion and held-out coverage prediction - the protocol's own FM20 primaries.
endpoint.lattice_fact_the_design_depends_on: Every common generalization of the positives is more general than or equal to their LGG (Plotkin 1970), so if the LGG covers a negative then so does every common generalization. There is therefore no 'specialize until consistent' disposition in pure anti-unification and the three dispositions are exhaustive.
endpoint.registered_classification_order: vacuity dominates over-generality: a bare variable is not an abstraction at all, so REJECT_NO_COMMON_STRUCTURE is returned even when negatives are also covered. Fixture KA-05 pins this.

oracle.primary: lgg_exhaustive: enumerate the generalization lattice of the first positive (antichains of positions x partitions whose blocks carry equal subterms), keep the covering patterns and take the unique minimum under the generality order
oracle.independent_cross_check: lgg_plotkin: anti-unification proper, folding pairwise generalization with a substitution table keyed by the pair of disagreeing subterms
oracle.uniqueness_is_verified: the exhaustive method verifies that the lattice minimum is unique up to renaming rather than assuming Plotkin's theorem; a planted positive confirms the uniqueness field is computed

arms.P0_FIXED_LESSON_INJECTION: frozen rule: keep the common skeleton, fresh variable at every disagreement, no sharing
arms.P2_CANDIDATE_ELIMINATION: Mitchell 1982 version spaces; specific boundary rejected when it covers a negative
arms.P3_MDL_COMPRESSION: minimum description length selection over the covering patterns
arms.F0_PARENT_FEDERATION: P1 supplies the term; P3's compression criterion may veto it as vacuous; P2's negative test may then veto it as over-general
arms.M_MINUS_VARIABLE_IDENTITY: ablation: fresh variable at every disagreement
arms.M_MINUS_LEAST_GENERALITY: ablation: stop at the most general covering pattern
arms.C_ALWAYS_ACCEPT: constant control with no abstraction of its own

comparator_justification: No single parent owns the endpoint. Plotkin's LGG produces the right term but has no notion of a negative example and no notion of vacuity. Candidate elimination owns the negatives but accepts a bare variable when no negative excludes it. MDL owns vacuity but chooses its own term and can generalize away a real shared regularity. The strongest faithful comparator is their federation under a pre-registered, outcome-blind rule.

mechanic_independence.statement: M does not call Plotkin's algorithm. It runs a cover-driven specific-to-general search of the kind used in inductive logic programming: start from the first positive, variablise the minimal set of positions where the current pattern fails to match the next positive (sharing a variable across positions carrying equal subterms), split a variable bound inconsistently, iterate until every positive is covered, then apply the compression criterion and the negative challenge.
mechanic_independence.why: A cover-driven search can variablise a position higher in the term than necessary, so it can diverge from the least general generalization. 'The federation reproduces M' is therefore measured rather than guaranteed - the defect FM10 had to repair before its protected run.
mechanic_independence.measured_on_development: On a 125-instance development probe the search initially diverged on 2 instances; both were traced to defects in M itself (a wrong fallback when a variable was bound inconsistently, and a variable-name collision that forced accidental sharing) and repaired before freezing. A broken mechanic is as much a strawman as a broken parent.

gates.G0a_KNOWN_ANSWER: every hand-authored fixture reproduced by the exhaustive oracle (>= 8 fixtures)
gates.G0b_ORACLE_SELF_AGREEMENT: the two independent oracle algorithms agree on disposition, lgg and coverage on every instance
gates.G0c_NULL_CALIBRATION: constant-response arms <= 0.40, random arm <= 0.40, M against within-split shuffled oracle labels <= 0.40
gates.G0d_DECOY_COVERAGE: each registered decoy family carries >= 3 instances
gates.G0e_PLANTED_POSITIVES: every registered planted positive trips its own gate predicate (>= 3)
gates.G0f_FAMILY_DISCRIMINATION: two independent halves with separate denominators: SOLVABLE (some non-control arm >= 0.95) AND SEPARATING (some registered weak arm <= 0.85)
gates.G1a_PARENT_REPRODUCES_M: F0 reproduces M's endpoint on >= 99.5% of instances and no family exceeds 5% discordance; AND the discordance counter is shown live on the same split by at least one ablation arm disagreeing with the parent; the per-family 5% rule is reported alongside the integer number of discordant instances it actually permits at this family size, so a threshold that collapses to 'no discordance' is not read as something laxer
gates.G1b_M_ADVANTAGE: detector: paired exact difference (M - F0) > 0, exact two-sided p <= 0.05, >= 1 family with >= 5 M-only-exact instances
gates.G2_ANTI_PERMISSIVENESS: on instances the oracle rejects, M accepts no more abstractions than F0 (>= 10 rejected instances required, else CANNOT_CHECK); AND the over-acceptance counter is shown live on those same instances by at least one arm registering a nonzero count - an anti-conservatism gate passing on 0 <= 0 with no demonstration that it could fire is a known defective shape
gates.multiplicity: Holm across the five per-family paired tests

gate_reporting_rule: Every gate reports the number of instances its rule was actually evaluated on. A gate below its registered minimum returns CANNOT_CHECK and never PASS, and the route line names every hard gate that could not be evaluated. A zero produced by a counter that could not have been nonzero is not evidence, so G1a carries a liveness control.
route_note: If G1a fails because M is WORSE than the federation, the route is still PARENT_SUFFICIENT: the parent is at least as good. That is recorded explicitly rather than presented as a study defect.

reproducibility.hash_seed_independence: the generator draws only from ordered sequences, never while iterating an unordered set. Verified, not assumed: the split's canonical digest is identical under PYTHONHASHSEED 0, 1 and 12345, asserted by tests/unit/test_fm_exact_suites.py::test_generator_is_independent_of_python_hash_seed. Python randomises string hashing per process, so a generator without this property would make a committed seed regenerate a different split elsewhere.
reproducibility.determinism: two consecutive runs produce byte-identical results and custody files
